adminStock.title: Inventory
adminStock.dailyLimitHint: Leave blank for unlimited; resets every day
adminStock.lowStockAlertHint: Shows a "Restock" warning when stock drops to this level
adminStock.stockTypeHint: Made = cooked daily until sold out; Purchased = bought to resell
adminStock.inboundNote: Recorded in the stock log and updates this item’s cost
adminStock.noStockItems: No items have stock tracking yet
adminStock.outOfStockHint: Auto-greys out as "Sold out" on the customer menu when zero
adminStock.balanceReadonlyHint: Stock balance is posted automatically by receipts / stock-takes / orders and is read-only here. To restock, use the Stock page.
adminStock.goToStock: Open stock page to post movements
adminStock.immutableHint: Posted entries can never be edited. Fix mistakes with a red-ink reversal (originals kept), or as super admin void an entry (removed from the books, recoverable).
adminStock.voidReasonPrompt: Reason for voiding this entry (required; recorded in the ledger audit):
adminStock.voidReasonRequired: A reason is required to void an entry
adminStock.reverseConfirm: Reverse this entry? A reversing entry will be added; the original stays.
adminStock.receiptFormHint: One receipt can hold multiple items; posting increases both the qty and value books and recomputes the moving average cost.
adminStock.reverseReceiptConfirm: Void receipt {code}? Reversing entries will be posted.
adminStock.takeFormHint: Enter counted quantities; leave blank to skip. Gains/losses are posted from counted − book.
adminStock.reconcileHint: A balance can only equal the sum of its entries. When book and ledger disagree, some legacy write bypassed the ledger — use the buttons below to recalc from entries.
adminStock.orderLinkHint: Looks for orders that were sold without deducting stock. A settled order with no stock-out entry is the worst case and can be posted directly — the posting is based on the ledger gap, so clicking twice never double-deducts.
adminStock.orderLinkOk: All orders and stock entries agree — nothing missing
adminStock.kindSettledUnpostedHint: The bill is settled but the ledger has no stock-out entry — sold without deducting
adminStock.kindOpenUnreservedHint: A purchased item on an open order was not reserved; posting at settlement will compensate
adminStock.kindStaleReservationHint: The order holds stock for too long (prepaid unpaid / postpaid unsettled)
adminStock.kindResidualReservationHint: The order is closed yet still carries a reservation
adminStock.repairNothing: Ledger already balanced — nothing to post
